title.value: ImageNet-X: Understanding Model Mistakes with Factor of Variation Annotations
title.justification: The paper titled 'ImageNet-X: Understanding Model Mistakes with Factor of Variation Annotations' introduces ImageNet-X, a dataset to analyze the failure modes of deep learning models using human annotations for factors of variation.
title.quote: To address this need, we introduce ImageNet-X–a set of sixteen human annotations of factors such as pose, background, or lighting for the entire ImageNet-1k validation set as well as a random subset of 12k training images.

extractions.description: The paper presents ImageNet-X, a dataset that annotates the ImageNet dataset with human labels of various factors of variation such as pose, background, and lighting to better understand the mistakes made by deep learning models.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is about understanding model mistakes and not explicitly linked to climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Deep learning vision systems are widely deployed across applications where reliability is critical. However, even today’s best models can fail to recognize an object when its pose, lighting, or background varies.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is analyzing deep learning model errors using variability annotations without a direct link to any climate or ecological sustainable development theme.
primary_category.quote: We introduce ImageNet-X, a set of human annotations pinpointing failure types for the popular ImageNet dataset.

secondary_categories.justification: There is no secondary theme linked to climate or ecological sustainable development within the paper's scope.
secondary_categories.quote: The paper deals with model annotations and failure analysis within AI models primarily.

primary_sub_category.justification: Since the paper does not relate to climate or ecological applications, no specific sub-category applies.
primary_sub_category.quote: ImageNet-X labels distinguishing object factors such as pose, size, color, lighting, occlusions, co-occurences, and so on for each image in the validation set and a random subset of 12,000 training samples.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no climate or ecological sub-themes associated with the paper's content.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The focus remains on technical aspects of model evaluation and robustness and not on environmental themes.

applications.value: Understanding model mistakes in deep learning using ImageNet-X annotations
applications.justification: The specific application of the paper involves using ImageNet-X annotations to understand factors leading to model mistakes, focusing on pose, background, and lighting.
applications.quote: Equipped with ImageNet-X, we investigate 2,200 current recognition models and study the types of mistakes as a function of model’s (1) architecture – e.g. transformer vs. convolutional –,...

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not propose a new climate or ecological sustainable development category since it focuses on deep learning model analysis.
new_primary_category.quote: To meet this need, we introduce ImageNet-X, a set of human annotations pinpointing failure types for the popular ImageNet dataset.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category is proposed as the paper focuses solely on evaluating vision model failures.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Understanding data augmentation and its effects to improve model robustness in deep learning vision systems.
